The '''1964–65 1.Lig''' was the seventh season of professional [[Association football|football]] in [[Turkey]]. [[Fenerbahçe S.K.|Fenerbahçe]] won their fourth title, becoming the first club to win four league titles.<ref name=turkishsoccer/>

==Overview==
[[Fenerbahçe S.K.|Fenerbahçe]] qualified for the [[European Cup]], while [[Turkish Cup]] winners [[Galatasaray S.K. (football team)|Galatasaray]] qualified for the [[European Cup Winners' Cup]]. [[Göztepe A.Ş.|Göztepe]] qualified for participation at the [[Inter-Cities Fairs Cup]]. [[Metin Oktay]] finished top scorer with 17 goals, winning his fifth Gol Kralı award. [[Altınordu S.K.|Altınordu]] were the only club relegated, while newly promoted [[Etimesgut Şekerspor|Şeker Hilal]] finished one point above relegation.<ref name=turkishsoccer />
